title: Numeric profile native lifecycle actor
status: prepared
---

This separate disposable-world actor uses the unchanged `profile-native-witness` observer on exact Factorio 2.0.77, Quality and public MIR 5.0.20014. It supplies eight numeric percentages through MIR's normal startup profile import against different valid raw dropdown defaults. The observer owns data/runtime recipe, recycling and pipeline expectations; this actor additionally checks the eight effective exported numbers.

Use the existing `Invoke-NativeFixture.ps1` protocol with case `profile-native-numeric`: create a zero-update seed, run the first server tick, retain its saved snapshot, and make two read-only cold observations of the same completed save. Only the first server observation writes actor storage or requests a save. The actor does not research technology, add bonuses or alter prototypes. Its settings-stage defaults are test inputs, not player changes.

Select the observer's committed `info-f200.json` as `info.json` in its exact caller-owned fixture projection, retaining the four shared Lua members. Do not select its Factorio 2.1 metadata or change its independently authored expectations. Both fixtures and the exact released MIR ZIP belong in the one owned F200 direct archive library; preserve and restore its controls.

The small case declares at most 16 MiB of new output for the seed/completed save and four bounded process logs, with no prototype JSON dumps or dependency copies. Exceeding that allowance is a refusal, not permission to retry with a larger budget. Memory, machine reserves, timeouts and library restoration retain their existing controls. Preparation or host checks do not establish native or stable acceptance.
